recipes.title: Frozen Strawberry Yogurt Protein Clusters (chocolate-dipped)
steps: Stir the protein powder into the Greek yogurt until smooth, then fold in the chopped strawberries.
Spoon into 8 mounds on a parchment-lined board or tray and freeze until solid, about 1–2 hours.
Dip each frozen cluster in the melted sugar-free chocolate, coating completely, and return to the tray.
Freeze again until the chocolate sets. Let them sit out a few minutes before eating.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the video has no narration or amounts, so quantities and macros are estimates (per cluster). Keep them in the freezer.
